literal_meaning: এককে একুশ করা (one to twenty-one making)
figurative_meaning_en: To exaggerate a trivial matter unnecessarily
similar_in_english: Make a mountain out of a molehill
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে ছোট একটা ভুলকে এক-কে একুশ করে তুলে সবাইকে অস্থির করল।
এই ঘটনাটাকে এক-কে একুশ করার কোনো দরকার ছিল না।
example_sentences_in_english: He turned a small mistake into a huge issue, making everyone uneasy.
There was no need to blow this incident out of proportion.
note: This idiom draws from numerical exaggeration, similar to arithmetic inflation for emphasis in Bengali folklore.
